items.headline: Tesla (TSLA) Deliveries Beat Expectations. But TSLA’s 159x Forward P/E Is Betting on Much More
items.summary: Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter, comfortably above company-compiled consensus of 461,974 and down only 2% from a year earlier.
